packages.name: nodejs
packages.why: npm, which the bats entries install with (win-prereqs.json:42, :47, :52, :58), comes with Node.js.

packages.name: uv
packages.why: The pre-commit, linode-cli and s3cmd entries install as uv tools (win-prereqs.json:71, :79, :84).

packages.name: python3
packages.why: The prose-wrap hook runs python3 (.pre-commit-config.yaml:281); the python3 link step points python3 at the newest Python this installs.

packages.name: bats
packages.why: The test gate runs bats under Git Bash (.github/workflows/tests.yml:47).

packages.name: bats-support
packages.why: tests/helpers/common.bash:19 loads it from BATS_LIB_PATH (npm root -g).

packages.name: bats-assert
packages.why: tests/helpers/common.bash:20 loads it from BATS_LIB_PATH (npm root -g).

packages.name: bats-file
packages.why: tests/helpers/common.bash:21 loads it. The npm registry's bats-file is a security placeholder, so it comes from the project's repository.

packages.name: pytest
packages.why: The python job runs pytest tests/python (.github/workflows/tests.yml:185), importable by python3.

packages.name: pre-commit
packages.why: The check config runs as pre-commit run --all-files (.github/workflows/tests.yml:225) and on every commit.

packages.name: s3cmd
packages.why: bin/s3cmd:55 runs the s3cmd uv installs; the bin/s3cmd step checks it from Git Bash.

packages.name: Pester
packages.why: The PowerShell tests need Pester 5 or later (tests/powershell/Install-Prereqs.Tests.ps1:1), beside the in-box 3.4.

packages.name: docker-desktop
packages.why: The docker_image pre-commit hooks (.pre-commit-config.yaml:48) and bin/docker_wrapper:102 run docker.
packages.slow: about 1 GB to download; this can take 20+ minutes
